25 | [waveform pattern] F02662 | Air-Fuel Ratio Lean Malfunction | (Calif.)
(1) When an air-fuel ratio feedback compensation value or adaptive control value continues at upper (lean) limit or at upper (rich) limit renewed for a certain period of time.
(2) When an air-fuel ratio feedback compensation value or adaptive control value feedback frequency is abnormally high during feedback control.
(3) When marked variation is detected in engine speed between specific cylinder during idle switch on and feedback condition. | • Injector circuit
